story.title: The journey from native gac arbors to your vibrant lips
story.quote: "Vietnam is endowed with some of the richest agricultural treasures in the world. Gaco chose gac and Ben Tre coconut to prove that Vietnamese botanical cosmetics can achieve both superior purity and supreme performance."
story.p1: In Vietnamese culture, the gac fruit is a cherished symbol of fortune and vitality. In cosmetic science, its vibrant red aril contains Lycopene 70 times more concentrated than tomatoes and Beta-Carotene 10 times higher than carrots.
story.p2: Through slow cold extraction without thermal degradation, Gaco preserves these precious vitamin precursors, blending them seamlessly with matured Ben Tre coconut oil to hydrate, protect, and gently fade discoloration.
story.caption: Natural farming terroir • Mekong Delta
story.step1Desc: Handpicking ripe red gac and matured coconuts from partner farms in the Delta.
story.step2Desc: Separating gac aril and low-temperature drying to preserve 99.8% of Lycopene.
story.step3Desc: Slow mechanical pressing without heat, capturing each pure droplet of ruby oil.
story.step4Desc: Enriched with vegan candelilla wax and housed in biodegradable kraft tubes.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions about Gaco
faq.q1: Does the balm contain lead or artificial colorants?
faq.a1: Absolutely not! The subtle natural blush comes directly from beta-carotene in organic gac fruit. Rigorously tested 0% lead and paraben-free.
faq.q2: Is it safe for pregnant women and small children?
faq.a2: Yes! Made entirely of food-grade vegan botanical oils, incidental ingestion is completely harmless, making it ideal for mothers and sensitive skin.
faq.q3: Does it genuinely fade lip discoloration?
faq.a3: Yes! High concentrations of lycopene and vitamin A/E suppress melanin production. Daily use for 2-4 weeks reveals visibly brighter, even-toned lips.
faq.a4: Inner Hanoi & HCMC takes 1-2 business days. Other provinces take 2-3 days. You can inspect upon delivery before payment.
